caption: Murten, Murten
composition: Murten ring wall and castle above Lake Murten · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Murten’s medieval ring wall, with its roofed rampart and round towers, wraps the old town, and the castle stands at the high end above the roofs. Lake Murten lies beyond the wall. The town is shown as it stands, without festival banners or scaffolding, in the canton of Fribourg. The Open-Meteo model is heavily clouded and warm, with soft light and no rain.
